conversion: Original meshes and placement; native-root curved plush pile with shape-aware feature grooming, gentle root shading and stable strand shadow sampling. Always-on fur, WASD and wheel flight, bed blanket preset, translucent menus.
bed_overlay: Procedural hinoki-style cloud bed with thick milk-tea mattress, separate pillow top, filled oat and rose pillows, and a volumetric dusty-rose duvet with woven normals, sewn channels and a turned-back oat fold. Toys and matching fur translate together. Original GLB and native fiber data are preserved.

bedside_accessories.placement: floor left of bed beside teddy rug
bedside_accessories.design: plain closed-toe, open-heel indoor slippers with padded footbeds and thin binding

door.design: arched pale hinoki timber, moon and star inlays, brass flower escutcheon
door.interaction: click or tap either doorknob to open and close; camera dragging does not toggle

hallway.camera_access: WASD, flight wheel and touch directions can enter through the open door and return
